info.title: Vairas User Management API
info.description: Global profiles and idempotent commands. Internal operations require a workload JWT. Delegated and platform mutations additionally require a user JWT in X-User-Authorization. Mutations return operation receipts; fetch current resource state separately.

post.description: Required workload scope and local client allowlist: profiles.binding.read.

400.description: Invalid JSON, required properties or command arguments (VALIDATION_FAILED).

401.description: Authentication required or user identity/session invalid (AUTHENTICATION_REQUIRED, INVALID_IDENTITY, SESSION_INVALID).

403.description: Access policy or current business authority rejected (ACCESS_DENIED).

409.description: Command identity, resource uniqueness or expected revision conflict; applicable codes depend on the command.

415.description: Unsupported request Content-Type (HTTP_ERROR); send a documented JSON media type.

500.description: Unexpected failure (INTERNAL_ERROR); preserve correlation ID and reconcile mutations before retrying.

503.description: Authoritative dependency or owned database unavailable (DEPENDENCY_UNAVAILABLE, DATABASE_UNAVAILABLE).

AssistantActorRequest.description: Exact identity/session supplied by a locally authenticated owner workload.

AssistantActorResponse.description: Minimal current active profile; no contacts or cross-school permissions.

BootstrapRequest.description: School-authorized bootstrap of the first administrator.

DeactivateRequest.description: Global deactivation of a user at a specific revision.

DocumentProfileResponse.description: Minimal identity fields for a specifically allowlisted document workload.

NotificationBindingResponse.description: Minimal identity binding. Email ownership is validated separately with Authentication.

ProfileRequest.description: Personal information for creating or replacing the authenticated profile.

RoleRequest.description: Role provisioning arguments; school and invitation are mandatory for staff roles.

UserContactResponse.description: Minimal contact details; a contact address can be absent.

DelegatedUser.description: Bearer <user JWT>, validated independently of the workload token.
DelegatedUser.name: X-User-Authorization
